summary: FB-01 (AI Galeri Desain — Gemini Nano Banana Pro, MODE DEMO) tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (status endpoint, mockup happy path incl. PNG serving + design doc reflection + version/status unchanged, validation matrix, submit gate ignoring ai_illustration, integrations gemini section + enable/disable + set/clear key, RBAC designer 200 / sales 403). Frontend: admin login -> entity KSC -> Desainer hub -> Galeri Desain: AI badge on DSG-PARANG-01, manage modal shows AI block with 'MODE DEMO', generate produced 'Ilustrasi DEMO dibuat (API key Gemini belum diisi).' + new thumbnail + 1024x768 preview image, deletion worked, Artwork (1) count unaffected. Integrations panel (Pengaturan & Master -> Master Data & Audit -> Integrasi AI) shows gemini-integration-panel below Anthropic panel; toggle+save shows gemini-msg and status flips to 'Ilustrasi AI dinonaktifkan.' then restored. No functional defects found. All settings/state restored (gemini enabled=true, no key); no test-created designs left behind.
critical_code_review_comments: FB-01 tests mutate GLOBAL integration settings (gemini enabled/api_key). Under pytest-xdist parallel default in pytest.ini these tests interfere with each other (a dummy key set by TestIntegrations made TestIllustrateMockup hit the real Gemini API and fail 400 API_KEY_INVALID). Run this file with -n 0 (documented in report); consider a serial marker or a settings lock if more such tests are added.
gemini_image_service._demo_render uses default PIL bitmap font, so the demo caption is tiny/low-legibility at 1024x768 — cosmetic only, acceptable for demo mode.

Review request said the Gemini panel lives under nav-settings-hub -> 'tab Integrasi'; actual path is hub-tab-admin (Master Data & Audit) -> admin-tab-integrations-button. Worth correcting in docs/handoff notes.
seed_data_creation: Temporary design 'TEST_Uji AI FB01' created for the submit-gate test and deleted; all AI illustration files created during tests deleted. The 2 pre-existing ai_illustration files on DSG-PARANG-01 (from main agent's manual verification) were left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run FB-01 suite serially: cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_fb01_ai_illustration.py -p no:randomly -n 0. It restores integrations state (gemini enabled, key cleared) via module fixture. Frontend: nav-designer-hub -> hub-tab-cs-design-gallery -> gallery-manage-dsgn_cf2ccad1866f-button for the AI block; Gemini admin panel at nav-settings-hub -> hub-tab-admin -> admin-tab-integrations-button.
rca_of_the_issue: Only failure observed was test-harness cross-talk from parallel execution against shared global integration settings, not an application bug; resolved by serial execution.
